<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Special Parliament session:</strong> The government is reportedly planning a special session of Parliament beginning September 18, with expectations centered on the Women’s Reservation Bill.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Electoral integrity debate:</strong> Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge has accused the BJP of undermining democracy through alleged vote manipulation, while the Supreme Court has directed the Centre to evaluate the use of totaliser machines to ensure EVM vote secrecy.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Youth and governance:</strong> Vice President C.P. Radhakrishnan emphasized the critical role of the youth in achieving the &#x27;Developed India 2047&#x27; vision during the National Youth Parliament in Nagpur.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxQWDJLeGZiNFFrV1VHckpQWldkTl9YZmNlV2dBc0VtTHdrTlJyNTR2MV82TExOSkczNUswcUt6TTA0dldBaWxydVFHa0N1c1E4NnBqbTZwOG1kVTQtTnVuOEx3RFRwd21GTlRRRmRPNzk4X0FocW54UmFvM0ZFenFNUGQ0OVg0eU96ZnVzZUFTSzRtTjhzZkR1cQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Security and economic policy:</strong> The Rajya Sabha has passed the Central Armed Police Forces Bill, 2026, as the government simultaneously moves to finalize its first National Global Capability Centres (GCC) policy.</li>
  <li><strong>Sovereignty stance:</strong> The BJP has reiterated its commitment to national sovereignty, asserting that the Modi government will not compromise on India&#x27;s territorial or strategic interests.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
</ul>
